
maria: that screams transitive bump — looks like yarl jumped to 2.x via aiohttp.

kevin: ran `poetry show --tree` locally, confirms aiohttp 4.x -> yarl 2.0 chain.

kevin: draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-inference/pull/4126 — revert poetry.lock
